title: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 5: False Rummy-Nose
native_title: アクアゾーン・オプション・ディスク・シリーズ５ ～ラミーノーズテトラ～
overview:
The AQUAZONE world expands even further with new fish, water plants, accessories and background images!

This option disc adds new content to Aquazone Desktop Life, the tropical fish simulator in which you feed your fish, treat them when they fall ill and watch them grow, pair up, spawn and raise fry. Option number 5 brings the false rummy-nose tetra and the A. sessiliflora water plant, decorations including a tree root, a Christmas tree, an Erawan elephant and a conch shell, and a set of new background images.

- Requires the Aquazone Saturn disc

新しい魚、水草、アクセサリー、背景画によってさらに拡がるAQUAZONEワールド!
